newsitem.title: UK: J. Sainsbury to offer home loans - paper.
newsitem.headline: J. Sainsbury to offer home loans - paper.

text.p: British supermarket chain J. Sainsbury Plc is teaming up with mutual insurer Standard Life, to offer mortgages along with groceries, said the Daily Telegraph newspaper on Wednesday.

Since it set up as a bank in February Sainsbury has attracted 300,000 deposit accounts. The move comes as Tesco Plc, Sainsbury's main rival, is to launch a low cost credit card on Wednesday, said the paper.
Sainsbury hopes that its low cost loans will take homebuyers away from banks and building societies, the traditional sources of finance for home loans, it said.
